name: Thai Red Curry with Lentils, Sweet Potato, Zucchini & Green Beans (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
½ lb green beans
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; stir to coat. Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until sweet potato is starting to soften, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a strainer, rinse lentils under cold water, then drain and transfer to a large pot; add broth. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove lid, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup green lentils, dried
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the lentils are cooking, trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the zucchini, drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sweet potato has started to soften, remove from oven. Add zucchini and green beans to the baking sheet, stir to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies are fork-tender, 10 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the lentils are done, add basil, coconut milk, water, curry paste, and sugar to the pot, then stir to combine. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
¼ cup Thai curry paste, red
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Add roasted veggies to the pot and stir once more to combine the curry. (If you prefer a thinner curry, add up to a 1/2-cup additional water to reach desired consistency.)

Divide curry between storage containers, then allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat curry in a saucepan or microwave and enjoy!
